name: KMJ Performance
old_description: With hundreds of thousands of performance parts on hand, KMJ Performance is your one stop performance shop! Our showroom features a complete line of parts, and accessories on display. The experience and dedication of our sales staff is the foundation for providing phenomenal technical support.
about:
KMJ Performance operates from Story City, Iowa, where it runs a showroom and parts counter serving the motorsports and performance automotive markets. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The business stocks hundreds of thousands of performance parts and accessories, ranging from engine components and ignition systems to safety gear, seats, towing equipment, and heating and cooling parts. Its showroom displays a complete line of products from brands such as Aeroquip, Assault Racing, Auto Meter, Coleman Racing, and its own KMJ Performance Parts label. The company also offers a parts-sourcing service, promising to obtain items not in stock.

Customers include dirt-track racers, performance enthusiasts, and repair shops seeking components for competition and street vehicles. The product categories span engine components, ignition and electrical, car and truck accessories, safety gear and seats, towing and winches, and heating and cooling systems.

KMJ Performance emphasizes the experience of its sales staff as the foundation for technical support, positioning knowledgeable consultation as a key differentiator in a market where part selection can be complex.
